title: Reflexive verbs
rule: Reflexive verbs carry me, te, se, nos, os, se: me levanto, te duchas, se acuesta.
The pronoun goes before a conjugated verb (Me ducho) or joins an infinitive, gerund or affirmative command (Voy a ducharme, Estoy duchándome, ¡Dúchate!).
Many daily-routine verbs are reflexive: levantarse, ducharse, vestirse, acostarse, llamarse.

questions: Mi hermano ___ ducha por la mañana.
With an infinitive the pronoun joins the end: ducharme.
With a gerund the pronoun can join the end, with an accent: afeitándose.
Affirmative command: the pronoun joins the end, with an accent: vístete.
With an infinitive the pronoun joins the end: acostarse.
